**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use covenant on us (Corio):

- **Grant of rights (§2)**: all licenses are non-exclusive; §2.7 restrictions are ordinary IP/scope terms (no copying, reverse engineering), not market restraints. No covenant not to host, build, buy or resell competing e-procurement products.
- **§13.6**: affirmatively preserves each party's right to develop independently.
- **§14.8**: confirms we solely direct the Corio Services and may subcontract freely.
- **"Corio Market Segment" / "Territory"**: these define the *scope of the licenses Commerce One grants us*, not limits on the businesses we may operate — and §2.10 lets us expand worldwide with consent not to be unreasonably withheld, while §1.3 lets us keep serving customers who outgrow the revenue threshold.
- **Exhibit D**: expressly "non-binding" sales and marketing cooperation, so no enforceable market limitation.
- **§11.3**: no post-term restraint survives termination.

No walk-away or fallback issues arise, so no edit is warranted under NONCOMPETE.
